items.name: theme
items.title: Minima theme
items.description: The whole design system as one CSS file: OKLCH ramps, alpha rungs, type, space, depth, motion, state, prose and syntax. Import it once after Tailwind and existing shadcn components pick it up unedited.

items.name: syntax-shiki
items.title: Minima syntax themes (Shiki)
items.description: Shiki themes generated from the same ramps as the CSS. Only needed if you highlight with Shiki; Prism and highlight.js are bound by class in the theme file itself.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: The class merger, taught about Minima's utilities. Without it a custom utility never collapses with the stock class it replaces, so both survive and the stylesheet order decides instead of your className.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: shadcn's button with every size and variant expressed in Minima tokens: control heights that follow density, radius that tracks height, and a destructive variant on an audited fill-and-text pairing.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: shadcn's input on Minima control heights, with a field text size that clears the 16px floor mobile Safari zooms below.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: shadcn's tabs with the grey-on-grey track replaced: the list is a recessed track and the active tab is a raised surface, so the selection reads in both modes.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A single measurement with an optional delta. Uses the figure register so digits align down a column, and treats tone as a state rather than a category.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A state as a chip: tinted ground, border, dot and label drawn from one hue at four different rungs.
